free_tier.stated: No free sandbox quota is published: VCI is a serverless, containerized compute service billed on actual uptime with the billing cycle accurate down to seconds and settled hourly; a managed VKE cluster also charges a cluster hosting fee of CNY 0.60 per hour for the Professional control plane. The registered list quotes $0.049/h billed per second for a 2 vCPU, 4 GB box.
free_tier.notes: VCI Agent Sandbox is a Kubernetes Agent Sandbox CRD running on serverless VCI pods with snapshot-based pause and resume and a warm pool; the VKE cluster hosting fee and the underlying compute and storage resources are billed separately from any sandbox use.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a serverless container sandbox, not an object

retention.stated: a paused VCI Agent Sandbox can keep its snapshot; the sandbox supports pause/resume with snapshot control and warm pools, but no fixed retention period for a stopped sandbox is published

egress.terms: not stated for VCI Agent Sandbox: the VCI overview documents compute, storage and network performance of instance families but no egress allowance or per-GB price

interface_detail: A Kubernetes Agent Sandbox CRD managed through the VKE control plane and API, with VCI Agent Sandbox compatible with the E2B protocol through the VKE E2B overview; the console and VKE add-ons create and manage the sandboxes.
tooling: VKE console, Kubernetes API with the Agent Sandbox CRD, volcengine-vci-admission for self-managed or cross-cloud clusters, and an E2B-protocol integration for managing VCI Agent Sandboxes.
chaining: The Agent Sandbox CRD and warm pools let an agent workload be scheduled into serverless VCI pods with snapshot-based resume, and the E2B protocol compatibility lets an existing E2B client drive it; it integrates with VKE networking, image cache and GPU families including the gni3 beta family.

limits.value: pay-as-you-go by the second, settled hourly; managed VKE cluster hosting is CNY 0.60/hour (Professional), CNY 9.10/hour (XL), CNY 21.80/hour (2XL) or CNY 50.90/hour (4XL)
using VCI Agent Sandbox requires a Volcengine account and a VKE cluster; signup offers phone registration with a +86 country code and SMS code

binding_note: A Volcengine account and a VKE cluster must exist before a sandbox can be created; the domestic signup presents a +86 phone field with an SMS code, and the registered corpus separately records that the free-trial quota requires mainland real-name verification.

identity_cost.detail: The signup page offers 手机号注册 (phone-number registration), a +86 country-code selector and a 获取验证码 (get verification code) button, plus account registration; starting the experience implies accepting the service terms and privacy policy. The free-trial quota requirement of mainland real-name verification is documented in the separate compute/volcengine-free-trial record. No other identity gate is published on that page.

reliability_note: Overdue accounts may have services suspended and resources released: within 2 hours of arrears service continues, after 2 hours resources are frozen, and after more than 360 hours frozen resources are released and cannot be recovered. Some instance families are beta or sold out and need an application or ticket.
confidence_note: The serverless per-second billing and VCI architecture are quoted from the first-party English VCI documentation, the cluster hosting prices from the VKE billing page, the Agent Sandbox capability from the product page, and the signup gate from the vendor signup page, all read on 2026-11-25.
